title: Tanker Chartering / Shipbroker
excerpt: We're looking for an experienced tanker chartering / shipbroking professional with existing owner, charterer and trader relationships across the VLCC, Suezmax, Aframax, LR and MR markets.
description:
DDS Marine is expanding its Chartering & Commercial team and is looking for someone with hands-on tanker chartering and shipbroking experience to join us in Malaysia.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience in tanker chartering / broking
  • Existing relationships with shipowners, charterers, traders or operators
  • Good understanding of VLCC, Suezmax, Aframax, LR and MR markets
  • Ability to handle enquiries, tonnage, cargo orders, indications, offers/counters and negotiations through to fixture
  • Strong understanding of charter-party terms
  • Ability to develop direct business, not only circulate market positions

Previous successful fixtures will be an advantage.

title: Marine Commercial Accountant / Post-Fixture Executive
excerpt: We're looking for a shipping or marine accounting professional to handle hire statements, off-hire calculations, charter-party accounts, voyage P&L and broker commissions in support of our chartering and vessel operations.
description:
DDS Marine is expanding its Chartering & Commercial team and is looking for someone with shipping or marine accounting experience to support our chartering and vessel operations in Malaysia.

Responsibilities

  • Hire statements and reconciliation
  • Off-hire calculations
  • Bunker ROB reconciliation
  • Charter-party accounts
  • Broker commission calculations
  • Port, agency and operational invoice verification
  • Voyage / fixture P&L
  • Receivables and payables monitoring
  • Final account reconciliation
  • Coordination with chartering, operations and management

Previous experience with a shipowner, ship manager, tanker operator, charterer or shipbroking company is preferred.
